thread:
maria (release): kicking off canary for infra-service v3.2.1 to eu-west-1 now. change window 10:00-11:00 UTC. posting runbook links and rollback criteria.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started: rollout_id=rl-2026-03-21-77, target=eu-west-1, cohorts=5%->20%

kai: noted. small smoke tests running on cohort-1, will post results in 5m.

ops_ash: runbook refs here: https://intranet.redwood.com/runbooks/deploy-safety-net and quick checklist: https://intranet.redwood.com/ops/handbook/deploy-checklist

maria (release): FYI if we need to pin back to previous image, use the control plane pin command: `rctl pin service infra-service --version=v3.1.9 --reason="canary-failure"`

sre-liz: agreed on thresholds: error-rate > 2% sustained for 5m OR 95p latency > 500ms for 10m -> initiate backout. Also any data-path regression flagged by QA -> immediate abort.

sam (prod): monitoring dashboards: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/infra/canary?var=rollout=rl-2026-03-21-77. watching traces.

kai: smoke looks clean, 0 new 5xxs so far. CPU uptick on one host but within expected.

deploy-bot: Cohort increased to 20%. status: healthy.

maria (release): small reminder: migration toggle is OFF (no schema changes). if we hit rollback, will be straight image pin.

ops_ash: prepping the rollback run: owner = @ops_ash, backup contact = @sre-liz. steps in runbook -> follow `rollback-fast` section. snippet to rollback attached for quick paste:
```
# rollback to previous stable
rctl pin service infra-service --version=v3.1.9 --operator=ops_ash --reason="canary rollback"
deployctl promote --rollout-id rl-2026-03-21-77 --action=abort
```

release-coordinator: if we do the pin, I'll notify support and restart the change window tracking. Also we'll mark release notes as reverted: internal ticket RN-3421.

deploy-bot: Alert: cohort-3 host i-0f4a5 reported OOM; restarting process, healthcheck flapping 00:01:12.

sre-liz: seeing a spike in p95 for a subset of endpoints (cache miss storm). tagging it as potential perf regression.

maria (release): on criteria — this is borderline. want to hold and observe 5 more minutes unless errors start rising. thumbs? :thinking_face:

kai: agree with observe. not yet hitting 2% errors. plan to roll back if it doesn't stabilize in 5m.

ops_ash: standing by to execute rollback. ready to run pin command and run deployctl abort if needed.

sam (prod): if we abort, can we gracefully drain traffic first? ops_ash: yes, `deployctl promote --action=abort --drain=true` will try to shift traffic.

maria (release): +1 to drain if we go. holding for 4m.

deploy-bot: Health status: rollout_id=rl-2026-03-21-77, cohorts=[20%], errors=0.8%, p95=420ms, unstable_hosts=1

maria (release): looks like it's recovering. keep monitoring. if it drops to stable for 10m we'll continue rollout. thanks all. :thumbsup:

kai: will do. posting final check when we hit 40%.

release-coordinator: noted — I'll update the release tracker and close the quick-rollback watch if we remain green after 10m.

deploy-bot: Canary checkpoint reached: 40% scheduled.

maria (release): moving to 40% now. everyone stand down unless anything new pops up.

sre-liz: thanks — will keep an eye on traces and error budgets.

(END)
